description: Paper-level knowledge graph linking papers, concepts, and POC experiments

nodes.title: VOYAGER: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models

concepts.name: Skill Library
concepts.description: External vector database mapping semantic embeddings of skill descriptions to executable code programs. Enables retrieval-based procedural memory without model weight updates.

concepts.name: Procedural Memory
concepts.description: Storage and retrieval of executable behaviors/skills, as opposed to declarative/factual memory. Key component of the thesis memory controller.

concepts.name: Automatic Curriculum
concepts.description: LLM-generated task sequences that adapt to agent's current state and capabilities, maximizing exploration or learning diversity.

concepts.name: Iterative Prompting with Execution Feedback
concepts.description: Closed-loop code refinement using environment state feedback, execution errors, and LLM-based self-verification across multiple rounds.

concepts.name: LLM Self-Verification
concepts.description: A separate LLM instance acting as a critic to verify task completion and provide corrective feedback, replacing hard-coded success checkers.

concepts.name: Code as Action Space
concepts.description: Using executable programs (rather than low-level motor commands or natural language) as the agent action representation, enabling temporal abstraction and compositionality.

concepts.name: Educability
concepts.description: The capacity of a model to acquire new knowledge and skills over time. VOYAGER operationalizes this as skill acquisition rate without weight updates (in-context lifelong learning).

concepts.name: Lifelong / Continual Learning
concepts.description: Ability to accumulate knowledge over time without catastrophic forgetting. VOYAGER achieves this via external skill storage rather than weight updates.

poc_experiments.title: Cross-Model Skill Library Transfer
poc_experiments.description: Build a skill library (50 skills) with GPT-4 in a task domain. Transfer to Claude/Llama-3. Measure zero-shot task completion rate vs. iterations-to-success. Tests whether executable skill libraries transfer across LLM backends.
poc_experiments.relevance: Direct test of inter-agent knowledge transfer — core thesis question

poc_experiments.title: Educability Benchmark via Skill Acquisition Rate
poc_experiments.description: Fix curriculum + task set. Vary base model (GPT-4, GPT-3.5, Claude-3, Llama-3). Measure iterations-to-proficiency curve per model. Produces a quantitative educability ranking.
poc_experiments.relevance: Operationalizes 'educability' as a measurable quantity — core thesis metric

poc_experiments.title: VOYAGER-style Agent for Research Tasks
poc_experiments.description: Replace Minecraft/Mineflayer with a research assistant domain (arXiv search + paper summarization + hypothesis generation). Skills = Python API functions. Curriculum = GPT-4 proposes research subtasks.
poc_experiments.relevance: Tests domain generalization of the skill library architecture beyond games
